If BlueWave accepts, Procurement will add the vendor to the early-pay queue and attach the pilot to the PO terms.

4) Documentation: we need a signed MSA (v3) and the completed onboarding PDF (with Tax ID). I've flagged this thread as high priority.

Attached below is the minimal procurement checklist we use (excerpt):
- Completed onboarding form (all fields)
- W-9 / tax docs
- MSA signed
- Bank remit details + sample invoice
- Set PO header mapping (RW_ProjectCode)

Lena — can you return Tax ID + sample invoice by EOD Monday? If you want, we can schedule a 20-min AP handoff tomorrow to walk through the PO header change.
